name: Calle Jorge east: white bench, street sign and lamp
trust: One white masonry bench with a scalloped back and an azulejo panel stands on the lawn side of Calle Jorge, on the left of IMG_2182 and IMG_2229 (looking back toward Dalí, headings 240 and 222). IMG_2231, IMG_2232 and IMG_2596 are that bench close up: blue tile skirting, a small hatch in the side, and a blue-yellow-green tile in the back. The pin cluster is ±2 to ±5 m, so the station (-40.72, 139.24), 1.55 m off the mapped centreline, is estimated. IMG_2597 shows the CALLE DE JORGE plinth and a black lamp on the opposite lawn edge at the east end; the plinth is placed 1.2 m off the centreline beside that pin (±2.6 m). Apple Maps 3D frames of this lane show the same pale path and white seats; they are not used to add further benches. Sizes are read by eye from the tiles.
